home.title: See how in sync you are
home.subtitle: Upload your couple chat history and discover the story, rhythms and numbers of the two of you.

privacy.title: Privacy comes first
privacy.p2: No message ever leaves your device.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: In the chat: ⋮ menu → More → Export chat → Without media. Upload the .txt or .zip file.

telegram.title: Telegram Desktop
telegram.body: On desktop: ⋮ menu → Export chat history → JSON format. Upload the result.json file.

consent.body: Sintonia runs only in your browser. There is no account. No message, name, or file is sent to a server. Closing or reloading the tab erases everything.
consent.label: I have read the notice and I declare that I have the right to analyze this chat, with the other person's agreement.
consent.hint: Check this to enable file upload. Do not use a chat you are not part of, or a group chat unless the other people have agreed.

drop.idle: Drag files here or tap to choose
drop.disabled: Check the consent above to upload files

home.demo: See a demo with fictional data

confirm.title: Confirm who is who
confirm.why: Each app stores names differently. Confirming the pairs avoids counting the same person twice.
confirm.ignore: Not part of the couple / ignore
confirm.needOne: Pick at least one name for {person}.
confirm.empty: Upload your files on the home screen to see who is who.

empty.title: No files to process
empty.body: Upload your files on the home screen to start.

timeline.title: Your story
timeline.subtitle: Use the arrow keys or drag to browse the milestones.

milestones.anniversary: {years, plural, one {# year of chatting} other {# years of chatting}}

desc.start: Where it all began. Since then, {total} messages.
desc.messages: You reached this number this month.
desc.telegram: This month Telegram had more messages than WhatsApp.

pace.label: Response pace by year
pace.note: Bottom strip: the median response time of each year against the usual pace of the couple ({time}). It is not a score, it only shows changes.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Tap a card to see the details.

sintonia.explain: Sync measures whether the conversation flows: whether messages get answered, how fast, and in what tone. It does not measure how much you care for each other, only what shows up in this history.
sintonia.short: History too short for a reliable score (at least 3 months and 500 messages).

detail.reciprocity: {pct} of conversations were answered by both sides
detail.tone: {pct} of messages with affection or laughter

sintonia.toneNote: Tone counts words from a list (affection and laughter). It is a simple measure: it does not understand irony or context. Apologies are not part of the score.

balance.explain: Balance measures whether the effort of the conversation is shared: who opens conversations, who sends more messages and words, and who closes. 10 is an even split. A couple can have high sync and low balance: one person leads and the other answers well.
balance.note: A high score does not mean a better relationship: it only shows how evenly the effort is shared.

stories.title: Story cards
stories.body: 9:16 images with numbers only, no messages.

prompt.title: Copy prompt for AI
prompt.body: The text carries only numbers and dates, never messages. Paste it into any AI chat.
prompt.dictionary: Include the couple's dictionary (nicknames and words only you use)

delete.body: Removes files and results from this tab's memory.
delete.confirmBody: You go back to the start and will need to upload the files again.
